message.content: {"choice":3,"reason":"Бесплатный shuttle даёт больше товара, чем produce, максимизируя будущую выручку."}
message.reasoning_content: Early game, cash 17M. Produce gives 2 goods for future sales. Bribing 5M to gain influence could help presidency, but money matters. Shuttle gives 3 goods free — better. Choose shuttle (3 goods, grey risk only at border? Actually shuttle grey goods may be confiscated ~25%). Still 3 goods expected 2.25 vs produce 2. Take shuttle.
